sentences.en: The doctor said: I paid you.
There is no more.

sentences.ar: قال جو الهندي: من خمس سنين، طردتني من مطبخ أبوك.
sentences.en: Injun Joe said: five years ago, you drove me from your father's kitchen.
Because I asked for food.
And I swore then that I would not forget.
And now it is your turn.
And he raised his hand against the doctor.
The doctor struck him, and Joe fell to the ground.

sentences.ar: وماف بوتر رمى سكينته، ونط على الدكتور.
sentences.en: And Muff Potter dropped his knife, and jumped on the doctor.

sentences.ar: والدكتور مسك لوح من القبر، وضرب ماف على راسه.
sentences.en: And the doctor grabbed a board from the grave, and struck Muff on the head.
And Muff fell without moving.
And in that moment, Injun Joe got up.

sentences.ar: لقى سكينة ماف عالأرض، وأخدها، وطعن الدكتور بصدره.
sentences.en: He found Muff's knife on the ground, took it, and stabbed the doctor in the chest.

sentences.ar: الدكتور وقع فوق ماف، والدم غطى الاتنين.
sentences.en: The doctor fell on top of Muff, and the blood covered them both.
And the moon vanished behind a cloud.
And Tom and Huck ran.

sentences.ar: ركضوا بالعتمة، بين القبور، بلا ما يتطلعوا ورا.
sentences.en: They ran in the dark, among the graves, without looking back.

sentences.ar: وبالمقبرة، جو الهندي حط السكينة بإيد ماف.
sentences.en: And in the graveyard, Injun Joe put the knife in Muff's hand.
And sat beside him, and waited.

sentences.ar: ولما فاق ماف، وشاف الدم والسكينة، ارتجف.
sentences.en: And when Muff came to, and saw the blood and the knife, he shook.

sentences.ar: قال: يا جو... شو صار؟ أنا عملت هاد؟
sentences.en: He said: Joe... what happened? Did I do this?
Injun Joe said: you.
You stabbed him with the knife.
And I saw.
And Muff, the drunk, believed him.

sentences.ar: وبكى، وقال: يا جو، ما تحكي لحدا.
sentences.en: And he wept, and said: Joe, tell no one.
I remember nothing.
And Joe said: I will not tell.
I am your friend.

sentences.ar: توم وهَك وصلوا للمصنع المهجور، وقعدوا عالأرض، وهم بيلهثوا.
sentences.en: Tom and Huck reached the abandoned tannery, and sat on the floor, panting.

sentences.ar: همس توم: هَك، شو رح يصير؟
sentences.en: Tom whispered: Huck, what is going to happen?

sentences.ar: قال هَك: إذا الدكتور مات، بيشنقوا حدا.
sentences.en: Huck said: if the doctor died, they hang someone.
Tom said: and do we tell?

sentences.ar: قال هَك: إذا حكينا، وجو الهندي ما انشنق، بيقتلنا.
sentences.en: Huck said: if we tell, and Injun Joe is not hanged, he kills us.
As he killed the doctor.
And they were silent, and then Tom said: we swear.
We write an oath in blood, and we do not tell.
And Tom wrote on a board:

sentences.ar: توم وهَك بيحلفوا إنهم ما بيحكوا أبداً.
sentences.en: Tom and Huck swear they will never tell.
And if they tell, they die.

sentences.ar: وشك كل واحد إصبعه بإبرة، وبصم بدمه.
sentences.en: And each one pricked his finger with a needle, and signed with his blood.
And they buried the board under the wall.
